host_plan.decision: S81.HOST (coordinator, 10-21, direct cabling): the host attaches only to the head dies (extra SerDes on head-die trays). Host traffic to stage dies (config, KV ingest, token in/out) rides in-band on the existing pipeline/stage circuits in calendar slots (20-30x bandwidth headroom). Stage dies have no host link: the s_7N host-plane port maps to the in-band route. Every tray carries a low-rate management sideband (boot/config: I2C/SMBus + 1GbE BMC class) to the rack management switch; it is not a SerDes.
